notes: Stories defined for server-side scope enforcement with strict allowlist validation aligned to GPTReader architecture.

stories.title: Allowlist Schema and Request Contract
stories.description: Define the allowlist schema and request validation contract for GPTReader requests, including permitted collections, query types, field filters, and max limits. Establish canonical structure enforced by Azure Function.

stories.title: Allowlist Configuration and Loading
stories.description: Implement configuration mechanism to define and load allowlist rules (collections, operations, constraints) into the Azure Function at runtime. Ensure immutability during request execution.

stories.title: Core Scope Enforcement Logic
stories.description: Implement server-side validation logic that enforces strict allowlist checks on every GPTReader request, rejecting any request with disallowed collections, query patterns, or parameter violations.

stories.title: Azure Function Request Interception Layer
stories.description: Integrate enforcement logic into the Azure Function entry point to intercept all incoming GPTReader requests, apply allowlist validation before execution, and return standardized rejection responses.

stories.title: Scope Enforcement Tests and Integration Coverage
stories.description: Develop unit and integration tests validating allowlist enforcement, including allowed requests, rejected out-of-scope queries, boundary conditions, and regression coverage for GPTReader flows.

per_feature.mitigation: Fail-closed validation: reject any request not explicitly allowed and log violations.
